references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, Abimelech burned the tower of Shechem with fire, a similar attack on a refuge tower that led to many deaths
The immediate result of Abimelech's attack on the tower of Thebez, where a woman dropped a millstone on his head
David refers to Abimelech's death at the tower of Thebez as a warning about the dangers of approaching city walls in battle
Gideon tore down the tower of Penuel, another example of the destruction of a fortified tower in the book of Judges
